paper_title: Incorporation of 2,6-Connected Azulene Units into the Backbone of Conjugated Polymers: Towards High-Performance Organic Optoelectronic Materials
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2017 - Xin - Incorporation of 2 6‐Connected Azulene Units into the Backbone of Conjugated Polymers /auto/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2017 - Xin - Incorporation of 2 6‐Connected Azulene Units into the Backbone of Conjugated Polymers .md

knowledge_points.content: The paper introduces a molecular design strategy using 2,6-connected azulene units to construct conjugated polymers, specifically creating the building block TBAzDI (N,N'-bis(2-decyltetradecyl)-6,6'-di(thiophen-2-yl)-[2,2'-biazulene]-1,1',3,3'-tetracarboxdiimide).
knowledge_points.evidence: Those incorporating 2,6-connected azulene units have not been reported. Herein, we report first two azulene-containing conjugated copolymers, P(TBAzDI-TPD) and P(TBAzDI-TFB)... BAzDIs were selected as new electron acceptor building blocks for constructing conjugated polymers incorprating 2,6-connected azulene units.

knowledge_points.content: P(TBAzDI-TPD) exhibits a high electron mobility of 0.42 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ in bottom-gate top-contact (BGTC) organic field-effect transistors, which is among the highest reported for unipolar n-type polymers in this configuration.
knowledge_points.evidence: OFET devices based on P(TBAzDI-TPD) exhibit electron mobilities of up to 0.42 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ which is among the highest mobility values for bottom-gate top-contact (BGTC) n-channel OFETs based on polymers.

knowledge_points.content: An all-polymer solar cell utilizing P(TBAzDI-TPD) as the electron acceptor and PTB7-Th as the electron donor achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 1.82%.
knowledge_points.evidence: An all-PSC device with polymer P(TBAzDI-TPD) as the electron acceptor and PTB7-Th as the electron donor exhibits a preliminary power conversion efficiency (PCE) value of 1.82%

knowledge_points.content: Azulene is a nonbenzenoid, nonalternant hydrocarbon with a large dipole moment of 1.08 D, consisting of a fused electron-deficient seven-membered ring and an electron-rich five-membered ring.
knowledge_points.evidence: Azulene, a nonbenzenoid aromatic hydrocarbon with beautiful blue color and a large dipole moment of 1.08 D... The nonalternant hydrocarbon character of azulene results from the fusion of an electron-deficient seven-membered ring and an electronrich five-membered ring

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations show that the LUMO in BAzDI-based copolymers is delocalized over both the acceptor and co-monomer units, allowing for efficient tuning of energy levels by changing the co-monomer.
knowledge_points.evidence: the electron density distribution of HOMO and LUMO is well delocalized over the TBAzDI and TPD (or TFB) moieties... Therefore, the LUMO levels of BAzDI-based copolymers are determined by both the BAzDI unit and the co-monomer unit and could be efficiently tuned by changing the co-monomer units.

knowledge_points.content: Grazing incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) reveals that both P(TBAzDI-TPD) and P(TBAzDI-TFB) adopt a predominantly 'edge-on' orientation with a short π-π stacking distance of approximately 3.55 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: Both polymers show multiple orders of alkyl (lamellar) stacking along qz indexed as (h00), indicating... a predominantly 'edge-on' orientation... corresponding to π-π stacking distance of about 3.55 Å which is among the shortest value for the polymers with high mobilities.

knowledge_points.content: The electron mobility of P(TBAzDI-TFB) increases significantly from 0.022 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ (as-spun) to 0.24 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ when annealed at 200 °C, correlating with improved crystallinity observed in GIWAXS.
knowledge_points.evidence: Thin films of P(TBAzDI-TFB) also displayed nice device performance with electron mobilities of up to 0.24 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ when annealed at 200 °C... thin films of P(TBAzDI-TFB) were found to exhibit stronger and sharper scattering peaks with the increased thermal annealing temperature

knowledge_points.content: The optical band gaps for P(TBAzDI-TPD) and P(TBAzDI-TFB) are estimated to be 1.57 eV and 1.60 eV, respectively, based on the onset of thin-film absorption.
knowledge_points.evidence: Optical band gaps (Egopt) of P(TBAzDI-TPD) and P(TBAzDI-TFB) estimated from the onset absorption of the thin films are 1.57 and 1.60 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The synthesis of the azulene polymers utilized palladium-catalyzed direct C-H arylation polymerization (DArP) as the final step to couple the brominated TBAzDI monomer with TPD or TFB.
knowledge_points.evidence: The copolymers P(TBAzDI-TPD) and P(TBAzDI-TFB) were synthesized via palladium catalyzed direct C-H arylation polymerization (DArP) using 8 to react with TPD and TFB, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Both 2,6-connected azulene-based polymers exhibit high thermal stability, with decomposition temperatures exceeding 400 °C according to thermogravimetric analysis (TGA).
knowledge_points.evidence: Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA) measurements revealed that both polymers have excellent thermal stability with decomposition temperatures of over 400 °C

knowledge_points.content: The LUMO/HOMO energy levels for P(TBAzDI-TPD) are -3.76/-5.82 eV and for P(TBAzDI-TFB) are -3.60/-5.76 eV, providing sufficient offsets (>0.3 eV) relative to PTB7-Th for efficient exciton dissociation.
knowledge_points.evidence: The HOMO/LUMO levels of P(TBAzDI-TPD) and P(TBAzDITFB) estimated from CV are -5.82/-3.76 eV and -5.76/ -3.60 eV... the ΔLUMO and ΔHOMO between these two polymers and PTB7-Th are larger than 0.3 eV, suggesting that exciton dissociation... might be efficient
